description: MOTO is an automated theorem generator for science. It's a creative novelty-seeking researcher with autonomous Lean 4 proof generation. Run for days at a time once pressing start - no interaction needed! Agents working in parallel from either local host LM studio, OpenRouter, OAuth or all 3. No internet required. Star us for more!
